summary: Frontend-only test of the checkout reliability fix and the direct sticky Buy Now on /business-bookkeeping-system. Every requested scenario passed on mobile (390) and desktop (1920). No payments were completed. Mocked error tests used page.route. 7 live unpaid Razorpay orders were created.

issues: The sticky button keeps saying 'Opening…' (disabled) for as long as the Razorpay modal is open, not just while it loads. It goes back to 'Buy Now · ₹X' when the modal closes. Cosmetic only, and the modal covers it.

verified: Sticky bbs-sticky-buy, desktop and mobile: no scroll, no buyer-email-dialog, URL and scrollY unchanged. Button shows 'Opening…'. Razorpay iframe opens with Price Summary 290 (create-order amount 29000).
Closing Razorpay (X, then 'Yes, exit') brings back 'Buy Now · ₹290'. After toggling the add-on in pricing, the sticky shows ₹439 and opens Razorpay with 439 (amount 43900).

bbs-hero-buy first click scrolls to pricing (scrollY 0 -> 5151) with no dialog. bbs-final-buy and bbs-pricing-buy open buyer-email-dialog. Submitting the email from pricing opens Razorpay and the dialog closes.
Exit offer does not appear while Razorpay is open, tested with a top-edge mouseout on desktop and history.back() on mobile.

Mocked 520 HTML response: 3 create-order requests, then toast 'Our payment server is busy right now. Please try again in a moment.' The raw Cloudflare text is not shown and the button returns to Buy Now.
/medical-6-combo: hero buy -> email dialog -> Razorpay (297) opens and the dialog closes.
critical_code_review_comments: razorpay.js createOrder also waits after the last failed attempt (an extra 2.4s before the error toast). Skip the delay when attempt === 2.
If create-order returns 200 without razorpay_order_id, it is retried and then the generic 'busy' message is shown. That is acceptable.
Back button while Razorpay is open: the exit offer is correctly suppressed, but the Razorpay modal stays open. Expected, since closeCheckout only closes our own dialog.
seed_data_creation: None. 7 unpaid live Razorpay orders were created by checkout tests (amounts 29000 x4, 43900, 29700, plus 1 more 29000).
context_for_next_testing_agent: To close Razorpay in tests, evaluate inside the api.razorpay.com frame: click button[data-testid=checkout-close], then the 'Yes, exit' button (data-testid=confirm-positive). Use history.back() through evaluate, because page.go_back times out on same-document popstate.
